**Non-negotiables:** Monday rest · Saturday long run · Everything else flexes around family, work, commitments.

panels.title: Week 2 — 25–31 May 2026 | Phase 1: Base Transition | Target: 38km · ~1,000m vert · Z1-Z2 only (Karvonen Z2 ceiling 142 bpm)

options.content:
## MON
### 25 May

🔴 **REST**

### Rest — Non-Negotiable
Post long-run recovery buffer. 196m altitude range yesterday.

HRV needs to reset. No athletic activity.

20 min walk is the absolute ceiling if restless.

**Type:** Rest

**Duration:** —

**Zone:** —

**Priority:** NON-NEGOTIABLE

Family, life, admin — this day is already claimed by recovery.

The long run loaded ATL to 36. Rest brings it down. That IS the adaptation.

## TUE
### 26 May

🟢 **RUN**

*(HRV gated)*

### Easy Trail Run — HRV Gated
**HRV ≥28ms:** 8–10km Z1-Z2, ceiling 138 bpm

**HRV 24–27ms:** 6km Z1 only, ceiling 132 bpm

**HRV <24ms:** 20–30 min walk only, no running

Morning preferred (pre-Vyvanse). Walk every climb that pushes above ceiling. Conversational pace on flats.

**Duration:** 55–70 mins

**Distance:** 8–10km (full) / 6km (modified)

**Zone:** Z1-Z2 (full) / Z1 (modified)

**HR ceiling:** 138 bpm (full) / 132 bpm (mod)

**Priority:** HIGH

**If work clash:** afternoon is fine — add 10 bpm to perceived effort post-Vyvanse but ceiling on watch stays the same.

Tuesday's run tells you whether Saturday can step up or hold. How the body responds here = your data.

CS target from today: ≥2.70 m/s confirms fitness direction.

## WED
### 27 May

💪 **STRENGTH**

#2

### Strength — Lower Body #2
Home gym. Afternoon gap preferred.

- Goblet squat 3×10 **(+2.5kg vs Week 1)**
- Romanian deadlift 3×10 **(+2.5kg vs Week 1)**
- Bulgarian split squat 3×8 each leg **(bodyweight still — tendons need 3 weeks)**
- Leg extension 3×15 (same or +5kg if Week 1 felt very easy)
- Side plank 3×35s each side
- Dead bug 3×10

Stop before failure.

**Duration:** 35 mins

**Progression:** +2.5kg goblet + RDL only

**BSS:** bodyweight (week 3 before load)

**Focus:** Quality over weight

**Priority:** MEDIUM

**If legs wrecked from Tuesday:** drop to bodyweight goblet and RDL. Quality over load — never skip entirely.

You are session 2 of tendon reconnection. Muscles remember. Tendons need time.

2.5kg is the progression. Resist adding more.

## THU
### 28 May

🟡 **RUN**
*(droppable)*

### Easy Trail Run — Most Droppable
Z1 only. Short and easy.

**Drop this session without guilt if:** Tuesday was hard · Work heavy · Kids need you · Legs still sore from Wednesday strength.

Saturday is worth more than this session.

**Duration:** 45–55 mins

**Distance:** 6–8km

**Zone:** Z1 only

**HR ceiling:** 132 bpm

**Priority:** LOW — drop freely

Success = done at Z1, OR not done.

Both are correct outcomes for this session.

If HR creeps above 132 on a climb: walk. Z1 ceiling is real today.

## FRI
### 29 May

🔴 **REST**

*(upper body
opt.)*

### Rest — Protect Saturday
Full rest preferred.

**If physically good + 30 mins free:** optional upper body and core only.
- Single arm DB row 3×12
- Overhead press 3×10
- Farmer carries 3×30m
- Hanging knee raises 3×12
- Side plank 3×35s

**No running. No lower body.**

**Type:** Rest (preferred)

**Optional:** 30 min upper body only

**Condition:** Must feel physically well

**Priority:** Rest > optional session

**No lower body work

Fresh legs for Saturday > second strength session.

When in doubt: full rest.

Family time, evening wind-down, early bed.

## SAT
### 30 May

⛰ **LONG
RUN**

⭐ ANCHOR

*(HRV gated)*

### Long Run — Anchor Session
**HRV ≥26ms:** 16–18km, Z1-Z2, ceiling 140 bpm

**HRV 23–25ms:** hold at 15km (same as Week 1), ceiling 140

**HRV <23ms:** 90 min max, no distance target

Early start. Z1-Z2 throughout. On terrain climbs: HR will exceed ceiling — that's the terrain, not overreach (confirmed by Week 1 data). RPE controls on climbs. HR controls on flat sections.

**Fuelling:** eat every 30 mins from minute 1. Race protocol practice.

**Duration:** 115–125 mins (full)

**Distance:** 16–18km (full) / 15km (modified)

**Zone:** Z1-Z2

**HR ceiling:** 140 bpm

**Vert:** natural (your terrain)

**Fuelling:** every 30 mins

**Priority:** HIGHEST

**Week 1 benchmark:** 15.72km, 113:48, avg HR 142, 688m GPS gain, 510m peak altitude.

Add 1km only if HRV recovered well. Don't add distance AND push effort.

**If can't do Saturday:** Sunday only if truly unavoidable. Rearrange the other thing.

Sunday is rest — go easy knowing recovery is already built in.

## SUN
### 31 May

🔴 **REST**

### Rest
Full rest. Short walk fine if legs genuinely loose.

No running. Refuel well tonight — Week 3 starts Monday.

**Type:** Rest

**Optional:** 20 min walk

**No running**

Family time. Early rest.

Phase 1 finishes 7 June. Week 3 is the final base week before intensity begins.

## Week 2 Targets

| Metric | Target |
|---|---|
| Total km | 38km |
| Long run | 16–18km |
| Vert | ~1,000m |
| Intensity | Z1-Z2 only |
| Strength | 1 session (Wed) |
| Run days | 2–3 |
| **Priority** | **Sat long run** |

---

**Entry state:** ATL 36 · CTL 44 · TSB +7.5

**HRV going in:** 23ms (mildly suppressed)

**Target HRV recovery:** ≥28ms by Tuesday AM

## What Can Move

🔴 **LOCKED:** Monday rest · Saturday long run

🟢 **HIGH:** Tuesday run · Wednesday strength

🟡 **CONDITIONAL:** Thursday run (drop freely)

⚪ **OPTIONAL:** Friday upper body

---

**Life events this week?**

Work clash Tuesday → afternoon run or modified session

Kids need Thursday → skip it, no guilt

Late Friday → full rest, no strength

Something clashes Saturday → move to Sunday only

## Phase 1: Base Transition
Weeks 1–3 | 18 May – 7 Jun

**Week 1 done:** 35.9km ✓

**Week 2:** 38km target

**Week 3 (1–7 Jun):** ~40km — final base week

---

## Phase 2 Starts 8 June
First structured tempo work enters.

These 3 weeks of Z1-Z2 discipline are not soft — they are the aerobic foundation Phase 2 intensity builds on.

**GPT100 race:** 6 Nov 2026 · 24 weeks out
